Description: System Power-On Reset & Clock Distribution
Test Objective: Verify proper reset sequencing and clock distribution across VeeR EL2 core and all 8 AXI slave peripherals
C Programming Part: startup.s: initialize registers after reset deassertion
SystemVerilog Part: tb_soc_data_buffering_top: generate 100MHz clk; assert rst_l low for 100ns then deassert
Test Procedure: Assert rst_l active-low for 10 clock cycles, monitor system state, release rst_l synchronously with clk
Expected Result: All registers reset to default values; internal rst signal deasserts cleanly without metastability
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS if system enters active state and responds to first bus transaction; FAIL if hung in reset

Description: VeeR EL2 Core Boot & ICCM Fetch

C Programming Part: startup.s: reset vector entry at 0xEE00_0000; initialize sp to 0xF004_FFFF (DCCM top)

Test Procedure: Deassert reset and monitor core fetch address on internal ICCM bus; verify jump to main()
Expected Result: Core fetches instructions beginning at 0xEE00_0000, executes initialization routines without trap
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS if main() execution starts and outputs banner; FAIL if trap/exception or illegal address fetch
